events.title: My Birthday Movie Pick: BASKET CASE (1982)
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
Come join me as I stream my birthday movie pick on my birthday!!
This is one of my favorite ridiculous horror movies:

BASKET CASE
1982 - 1hr 31mins
Body Horror/Dark Comedy/B-Movie

A young man carrying a big basket that contains his extremely deformed, formerly conjoined twin brother seeks vengeance on the doctors who separated them against their will.

**August 2** \- Episodes 1 \- 2
**August 9** \- Episodes 3\-4
